newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Green's Foods sees lower 2nd half, year up.
newsitem.headline: Green's Foods sees lower 2nd half, year up.

text.p: Green's Foods Ltd said on Friday that earnings for the second half of the 1996/97 year ending June 30 would be below expectations, but that the result for the year would be higher than the previous year.

Green's said the result for the June 30 half year had been adversely affected by higher than expected costs relating to the closure of U.K. operations, range rationalisation and product deletion programmes, restructuring costs and flat retail trading conditions.
"On a positive note, trading improved towards the end of May and has maintained momentum," the company said in a statement.
